falsifier: Per pulse, the frozen revival rule as registered: 250 active days or 100 events, published-direction mean positive at t at or above 2. A family whose accrual reaches its count without meeting the rule does not enter the basket, and that non-entry is the falsifier firing, printed at the B5 of that week.

families.construction: long SPY on the last trading day of a month and the first three trading days of the next (Lane B port construction, BUGLOG_2026-11-15.md); desk calendar form decides last/first trading days on business days minus the registered holidays

the rolling-z Gatev distance form on XOM/CVX, JPM/BAC, WMT/COST, MA/V: log-price ratio 252-session trailing z decided at the close, enter at |z| above 2 (z above 0: short A long B), exit at |z| under 0.5 or after 20 sessions, 10bp per pair on entry and exit days in the leg series (Lane B port construction, BUGLOG_2026-11-15.md)

the Item 2.02 event drift form at +5 and +21 sessions: surprise is the event session's excess return versus SPY, terciles over the pooled forward events, top tercile long and bottom tercile short held through +21 sessions (Lane B port construction, BUGLOG_2026-11-15.md)

first_trade_condition: First basket entry on the first session after the first pulse family fires its revival rule, at the sizing above, reported as a revival rostering with the rule print attached.
genesis_basis: The accruals themselves, running from Mon 2026-11-16. Genesis basis: pairs 1,469 active days at +1.04bp per active day in its genesis sample; that figure is the hypothesis the forward accrual re-earns, not a forward claim.
kill_rule: A family failing its frozen rule at its count stays buried and never enters the basket; the basket itself retires if every fired family grades non-positive over its first 20 basket sessions.
object: Graveyard revival pulses, turn-of-month pairs and PEAD
revival_rule: a leg is declared REVIVED only if its forward read, at 250 further active days (or 100 further events for PEAD), shows its published-direction mean positive with t at or above 2 in the forward window alone
sizing: One standard desk sleeve slice for the basket, split equally across fired families; a single fired family carries the whole slice only at half weight until a second family fires.
status: LIVE 2026-11-16 (CONV123-REVIVAL-20261116); paper only, standard $10,000 slice, basket over fired revival families only; every family accruing from Mon 2026-11-16 at this landing, so the basket is flat until the first family fires its frozen rule
